source_text: Non coquetur fermentatum. Fermentum malitiae expurga. Azymi sinceritatis.
pass_a_gloss: Not it-will-be-baked leavened. Leaven of-malice purge-out. Unleavened of-sincerity.
pass_b_english: It shall not be baked [[leavened >> Bible:Leviticus 6:17]]. Purge the [[leaven of malice >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:8]]. Keep the unleavened bread of sincerity.
